To make it easier for you being a coach your players/parents can answer if they are going to attend the training, and you can send them reminders if they haven't answered. In this way you as a trainer will know how many that will show up and Pocket Coach can provide you the best suited exercises based on that number. With Pocket Coach your players can also see what you are going to do in the practice so that they can come prepared.

In Pocket Coach we also believe that if the players want to maximize their potential they also need to do some work in between the training sessions. Hence we have made a library with a lot of exercises you can do by yourself or with others.
